teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Your AI-generated content sounds exactly like everyone else's. Brutal. Can Claude Projects fix that? One limit changes the answer.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk, frowning at identical stacked drafts, medium shot, warm evening lamp light, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Workspace
teile.text: A project is a self-contained workspace with its own chat histories and knowledge base. You can upload documents and context.
teile.szene: Painted urban game-poster style: presenter in cyan glasses sorts handwritten notes and sample pages into a glowing folder-shaped workspace on a tabletop, close shot, soft cyan light, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Context
teile.text: Upload your own notes and documents. Claude uses them to understand the background for chats inside that project.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: presenter in leather jacket writes at a studio table surrounded by pinned sketches and folders, a faint holographic assistant silhouette listening beside him, medium shot, teal and amber lighting.

teile.name: Instructions
teile.text: So how do you shape the voice? Add project instructions, like a formal tone or an industry role.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: presenter leans toward a laptop, one hand raised as if dictating guidance, thoughtful expression, medium close shot, dim room with cool cyan glow.

teile.name: Limits
teile.text: Here's the limit. Free accounts get five projects. Paid plans can expand knowledge up to 10x as it grows.
teile.szene: Painted urban game-poster style: presenter at a street-side cafe table weighing two options, one hand raised with five fingers, closed wallet beside a coffee cup, medium shot, golden afternoon light.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: Projects draw from your plan's usage. Your next guide can start from your own notes, not everyone else's.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: presenter in cyan glasses leans back at his desk with a satisfied smile, stacked notebooks beside him, medium shot, warm desk lamp, calm top and bottom space.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses gives a confident thumbs-up beside a stack of notebooks, medium shot, sunset city backdrop.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chats and knowledge bases, per Claude's help page. Free accounts can create five; paid plans can expand knowledge capacity up to 10x.
